### 1 — Scene
A cooked breakfast: fried eggs, grilled tomato halves and mushrooms, with a muffin, orange juice, a small coffee, and a dark sauce.

### 2 — Vessels
- Main plate: approximately **26 cm** diameter; area **531 cm²**.
- Muffin side plate: approximately **20 cm** diameter; area **314 cm²**.
- Juice glass: approximately 6.5 cm internal diameter.
- Small coffee cup and sauce pot.

The muffin plate appears to belong to this meal, so it is included.

### 3–6 — Items, coverage, volume and weight
Heights are average food thicknesses, rather than peak heights. Bulk density is applied once.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Estimated weight |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Two fried eggs | 30% of main plate | 159 × 0.75 = 119 ml | 0.95 g/ml | 113 g |
| Grilled tomato halves | 19% | 101 × 1.5 = 152 ml | 0.65 g/ml | 99 g |
| Cooked mushrooms | 16% | 85 × 1.1 = 94 ml | 0.65 g/ml | 61 g |
| Visible cooking-oil sheen | Overlaps cooked foods | Approximately 4 ml | 0.92 g/ml | 4 g |
| Muffin | 16% of side plate | 50 × 4 = 200 ml | 0.45 g/ml | 90 g |
| Orange juice | Glass cross-section | 33 × 9 = 297 ml | 1.04 g/ml | 309 g |
| Coffee, apparently black | Cup cross-section | 20 × 2 = 40 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 40 g |
| Dark sauce | Small pot cross-section | 7 × 1.4 = 10 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 10 g |

**Coverage check:** solid foods cover approximately **65% of the main plate** and **16% of the side plate**. Oil overlaps those areas rather than adding coverage.

### 7 — Energy
| Item | kcal per 100 g | Estimated kcal |
|---|---:|---:|
| Eggs, with cooking oil counted separately | 155 | 175 |
| Grilled tomatoes | 25 | 25 |
| Cooked mushrooms | 30 | 18 |
| Cooking oil | 884 | 35 |
| Muffin | 390 | 351 |
| Orange juice | 45 | 139 |
| Black coffee | 2 | 1 |
| Dark sauce, assumed savoury | 80 | 8 |

### 8 — Sanity check
The main plate contains approximately **277 g**, plausible for two eggs, two tomato halves and several mushrooms. Including the muffin, sauce and drinks gives approximately **726 g and 752 kcal**. Muffin density, cooking fat and sauce identity are the largest uncertainties.
